title: Matrix directions and strategy codes are opaque
description: The baseline desktop chart says ROW VS and compresses all nine team styles into unexplained two-letter codes.
expected: A non-technical player can identify their row, the enemy column, and every team style without decoding shorthand.
observed: ROW VS and codes such as BS, DR, and ZC require prior design knowledge.

title: Mobile matrix lacks reading and scroll guidance
description: The baseline phone view shows cropped columns without explaining row-versus-column direction, score meaning, or how to reach the remaining opponents.
expected: The phone layout visibly teaches the chart and tells the player to swipe sideways.
observed: The remaining columns and the meaning of the numbers are unexplained.
